app.name: WiiLink Patcher Wii (Unofficial)
app.long_description:
Unofficial community client created by Darksito and Mila Soraki. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by WiiLink.
It downloads titles from NUS, applies WiiLink BSDIFF patches, and writes generated WAD files to usb:/WAD. Support applications are downloaded separately by the client when required.
It never installs WAD files or writes to NAND automatically. Verify the WAD region and keep a NAND/BootMii backup before installation. Persistent debug logs, crash reports, stack traces, and on-screen debugging are included.
Controls: A - Select B - Back D-Pad - Move 1 / X - Toggle on-screen debug HOME / START - Exit
